newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 index closes slightly lower again.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 index closes slightly lower again.

text.p: The Czech PX50 and RPIX indices continued to slide on Wednesday with the top four most heavily capitalised issues all moving lower.
SPT Telecom closed down 10 crowns to 3,080, Komercni Banka lost 30 crowns to 2,050, Ceska Sporitelna dropped four crowns to 312 and CEZ fell nine crowns to 971.
In the construction sector IPS Praha continued to confound analysts' postive feelings on the company's potential. On Wednesday IPS fell one crown to 271.
Investment bank Patria finance, in a recent report, recommended IPS shares as a buy at current prices.
"We consider IPS a very promising company with a strong market market position and excellent growth potential," Patria said.
At the end of October, IPS conducted a 10 for one stock split bringing the new number of its outstanding shares to 14.3 million.
Overall, activity remained depressed on the bourse, with turnover at just under 700 million crowns.
